_comment: Controlled tag vocabulary for meeting summaries. ids are what the model may output (enforced by the structured-output schema); descriptions are shown to the model; groups map to the site's 8 categorical colors in this order. Adding a tag: append it here, then re-summarize. Removing or renaming one: re-summarize affected meetings.
